variants.headline: Working people deserve better stewardship
variants.body: Food is short in {colony}, and people are hungry. Working households need enough to eat; a debate cannot fill that need. We fault {target}.

variants.headline: Hunger calls responsibility to account
variants.body: Residents are hungry because food is insufficient in {colony}. Solidarity starts with treating enough to eat as a common need. We fault {target}.

variants.headline: Food failure demands a plain answer
variants.body: There is too little food in {colony}, and people are hungry. Enough to eat is a basic condition of a decent life. We fault {target}.
